title: Import audio
description: Plays an audio (WAV) file of the project as a sound source, optionally only a part of it, offset in time or looped. The file is identified by its content, so the song keeps working if the file is renamed. It needs a file and gives audio.

outputs.name: body
outputs.title: Loop body
outputs.description: The loop with its joins silent. Together with the loop seam it gives the whole loop again.

outputs.name: loop-region
outputs.title: Loop seam
outputs.description: Only the joins of the loop, where the end of a pass blends into the start of the next, silent elsewhere. Chain effects on it to change just the joins; bring it back with a region-merge block. It can never connect to an audio input.

parameters.name: file
parameters.doc: Project-relative audio file to import. WAV is read directly; mp3, flac, ogg and aiff are decoded with ffmpeg (it must be on the PATH).
parameters.placeholder: choose an audio file of the project

parameters.name: start
parameters.doc: Where in the file the sound starts, in seconds (empty: the beginning).

parameters.name: end
parameters.doc: Where in the file the sound ends, in seconds (empty: the end of the file).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.doc: Where in the block the sound starts: seconds ("1.5", "1.5s") or beats ("2 beats"). Negative cuts the start off. Empty: at the start of the block.

parameters.name: loop
parameters.doc: On repeats the chosen stretch until the block ends.

parameters.name: loop_start
parameters.doc: With loop on: where in the file the repeating part starts, in seconds. What lies before it plays once (an intro). Empty: the start of the stretch.

parameters.name: loop_end
parameters.doc: With loop on: where in the file the repeating part ends, in seconds. What lies after it plays once at the end of the block (an outro). Empty: the end of the stretch.

parameters.name: crossfade
parameters.doc: With loop on: how long the end of a pass is blended into the start of the next one at every repeat, so a short recording repeats without a click (empty or 0: a plain repeat). Seconds ("3", "3s"), beats ("2 beats") or bars ("1 bar"). The looped stretch must be at least twice as long. The first pass plays plain; the blend starts at the second pass.

parameters.name: crossfade_curve
parameters.doc: The shape of the blend: equal-power keeps the level for unrelated material such as rain (default); linear for related material; cosine is an S-curve; log keeps both sides loud through most of the overlap.

parameters.name: fingerprint
parameters.doc: How the imported file is identified when checking whether its source changed.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: An audio (WAV) file of the project (parameter file).
